ownership_seam.owner: NumericExecution/NumericReuse private lifetime; exactly one selected backend owner, no global/process cache
ownership_seam.opening: Create lazily at first computed selected pair, retain backend for that numeric execution, close its FD exactly once on owner terminal cleanup. Constructor and failure paths transfer ownership only after all required initialization succeeds.
ownership_seam.sessions: PairExecutor passes a borrowed backend reference to each immutable session; session close disables/clears only session-local borrowing state, never closes shared backend. Prevent borrower use after owner poison/close; retain sequential ownership assumptions or explicitly refuse concurrent borrowers.
ownership_seam.checks: Retain policy.current/join and normalizer function/object/code pins at original session boundaries and advances. Split reference/runtime/helper/library validation from allocation so every existing per-session check remains at its original point; compare the fresh validated body with the owner sealed backend identity. Preserve _live descriptor/seal checks and all original authority callbacks/schedules.
ownership_seam.cleanup: NumericExecution.close already calls memo.close; add owned backend cleanup in that owner chain with original primary/fatal/ambiguous-close semantics and no retry. Owner poison disables borrowed use. Removing pair-local close must not mask failures elsewhere.
ownership_seam.claim_limit: Reduces loader attempts from per-computed-session to per-numeric-owner by construction if correctly implemented; does not establish OS unload, mapping size, speed, whole capacity or library numerical validity. Unimplemented.
